- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/26 (Fri) 21:23
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Course Title: "Language, Form, and Everything in Between"
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Course Description: Explores the relationship between language and form, examining how language shapes perception and how forms communicate ideas, emotions, and messages.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 1 Activities: Introduction to the course, defining language and form, analysis of visual and linguistic forms in works of art.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 2 Activities: Lecture on the Sapir-Whorf hypothesis, discussion on language's influence on perception, writing and visual art exploration.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 3 Activities: Lecture on forms and structures in art and design, discussion on communication roles, analysis of art and design works.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 4 Activities: Lecture on language and architecture, discussion on design influence, analysis of buildings and cities.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 5 Activities: Lecture on advertising and marketing forms, discussion on communication roles, analysis of advertisements and campaigns.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 6 Activities: Lecture on literature and poetry forms, discussion on literary expression, exploration of different literary forms.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 7 Activities: Lecture on forms and culture, discussion on cultural values, analysis of cultural artifacts.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 8 Activity: Final project exploring the relationship between language and form in a chosen context.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assessment Breakdown: Class participation and attendance: 20%, Weekly assignments and activities: 40%, Final project: 40%.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Note: The syllabus is a sample and can be adapted to fit course needs.
